ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.4/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.4/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.4/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

**Updating?** Copy the new files over your old ChurchStream folder; your **ChurchStream-data** folder (settings, songs, services) is kept. First time? See the install steps in the [README](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream#install-windows).

## New in 0.3.4: PowerPoint files and a quicker way to add songs
- **PowerPoint in the service:** **+ Add → Slides** now takes the pastor's PowerPoint file (.pptx or .ppt), picked or dropped on the dialog. PowerPoint on the computer opens it in the background, so the slides look exactly the same; this can take up to a minute. Keynote (Mac) or LibreOffice are used if PowerPoint isn't installed. PDFs and pictures still work too. Animations, videos and sounds inside a PowerPoint don't carry over; add videos with *Video, music or YouTube*.
- **Song or chorus** is now the first item under **+ Add**: type or paste the words and press **Save and add to service**. The song is kept in your library and added to the end of the order of service.
- Imported song titles keep their apostrophes correctly (He’s, not He’S).

*On a Mac, the first time you add a PowerPoint file, macOS may ask whether ChurchStream may control PowerPoint: click OK.*

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
